rules.label: Colorado Hospital Discounted Care limits at or below 250% FPL
rules.quote: For patients whose income is at or below 250% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines, the limits to how much the hospital can charge must follow the rules of Hospital Discounted Care.

rules.label: 100% charity discount at or below 250% FPL, non-elective care
rules.quote: with sufficient supporting documentation provided by the patient, will have a 100% Charity discount processed.

rules.label: expanded assistance from 251% to 400% FPL
rules.quote: For patients whose documented income is between 251 and 400 percent of the Federal Poverty Level

notes: Hand-written reference model of the web page (HCA HealthONE is for-profit, so 501(r) does not apply). The charity tier also requires that the patient not qualify for state or federal assistance; left out as ambiguous.
